newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound almost unchanged against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound almost unchanged against the dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound remained almost stable against the dollar on Monday in a private sector market well supplied with the U.S. currency, bankers said.
"The market is liquid in dollars," one banker said.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3890 and 3.3920 bid and 3.3900 and 3.3940 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average rate was 3.390625 bid and 3.392125 offered, compared to 3.39075 pounds bid and 3.392375 pounds offered on Sunday.
The central bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.387778 pounds buy and 3.395704 pounds sell.
